svg.title: mietkartei — six typography variants
svg.desc: A: Helvetica Neue Medium, current direction. B: Helvetica Neue Bold. C: Helvetica Neue Medium with more space between letters and lines. D: Avenir Next Demi Bold. E: DIN Alternate Bold. F: Futura Medium. Every logo uses the original typeface outlines.

g.text: Six options using real typefaces. Same stacked layout and comparison width.
More space between letters and lines
A is the current logo. Every direction is available as black and white SVG.
